```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers to promisify getInfo
  function getInfoAsync(eeObject) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      eeObject.getInfo((res) => resolve(res), (err) => reject(err));
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const lon = -122.403124;
  const lat = 40.575441;
  const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]);
  const region = pt.buffer(25000).bounds(); // ~25 km buffer to capture coarse reanalysis grid
  const dayStart = '2020-08-25';
  const dayEnd = '2020-08-26'; // inclusive end-exclusive filterDate range
  const monthStart = '2020-08-01';
  const monthEnd = '2020-09-01';

  console.log(`Location: ${lon.toFixed(6)},${lat.toFixed(6)}; Date: 2020-08-25`);

  // Candidate datasets and date windows
  const candidates = [
    { id: 'ECMWF/CAMS/NRT', start: dayStart, end: dayEnd },
    { id: 'ECMWF/CAMS/REANALYSIS', start: dayStart, end: dayEnd },
    { id: 'NASA/MERRA2/M2T1NXAER', start: dayStart, end: dayEnd },
    { id: 'NASA/MERRA2/M2TMNXAER', start: monthStart, end: monthEnd },
    { id: 'NASA/GSFC/MERRA2/inst1_2d_aer_Nx', start: dayStart, end: dayEnd },
    { id: 'NASA/GSFC/MERRA2/mon1_2d_aer_Nx', start: monthStart, end: monthEnd },
  ];

  // Function to pick likely black carbon total column band
  function pickBCColumnBand(bandNames) {
    // Prefer explicit total column names; avoid AOD and mixing ratio
    const lower = bandNames.map((b) => b.toLowerCase());
    const exactPrefs = ['totcolbc', 'total_column_black_carbon', 'bc_total_column', 'totalcolumnblackcarbon'];
    for (const pref of exactPrefs) {
      const idx = lower.indexOf(pref);
      if (idx >= 0) return bandNames[idx];
    }
    // Generic heuristic: includes 'black' & 'carbon' & 'column', exclude 'aod' and 'mix'
    for (let i = 0; i < lower.length; i++) {
      const b = lower[i];
      if (b.includes('black') && b.includes('carbon') && b.includes('column') && !b.includes('aod') && !b.includes('mix')) {
        return bandNames[i];
      }
    }
    // Fall back to common MERRA-2 name
    for (let i = 0; i < lower.length; i++) {
      const b = lower[i];
      if (b.includes('totcol') && b.includes('bc')) return bandNames[i];
    }
    return null;
  }

  let finalTag = null;
  let foundImages = false;
  let seenNoValidPixels = false;

  try {
    for (let idx = 0; idx < candidates.length; idx++) {
      const cand = candidates[idx];
      let col;
      try {
        col = ee.ImageCollection(cand.id).filterDate(cand.start, cand.end).filterBounds(pt);
        const size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        console.log(`Try ${idx + 1}: ${cand.id} -> images=${size}`);
        if (size === 0) continue;
        foundImages = true;

        // Compose to a representative image (mean for hourly/daily, first for monthly also okay)
        const img = col.mean();

        // Probe band names
        const bandNames = await getInfoAsync(img.bandNames());
        const band = pickBCColumnBand(bandNames || []);
        if (!band) {
          // No suitable BC column band found in this dataset
          continue;
        }

        // 3. Processing: compute counts and mean over region
        const countDict = await getInfoAsync(
          img.select(band).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: 20000,
            maxPixels: 1e9,
          })
        );
        const count = (countDict && countDict[band]) ? countDict[band] : 0;
        if (!count || count === 0) {
          seenNoValidPixels = true;
          // Try next dataset
          continue;
        }

        const meanDict = await getInfoAsync(
          img.select(band).reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: 20000,
            maxPixels: 1e9,
          })
        );
        const val = meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null;

        // 4. Calculation: Convert to mg/m^2 if unit is kg/m^2 (typical for total column mass)
        if (val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val)) {
          console.log(`Band ${band}: mean is null/NaN`);
          finalTag = 'C3';
          break;
        }
        if (val < 0) {
          console.log(`Band ${band}: negative value (${val}) invalid`);
          finalTag = 'C3';
          break;
        }

        const kgPerM2 = val;
        const mgPerM2 = kgPerM2 * 1e6; // 1 kg = 1e6 mg

        // 5. Validation & Final Answer
        console.log(`Band: ${band}; Pixels: ${count}; kg/m^2: ${kgPerM2.toExponential(3)}; mg/m^2: ${mgPerM2.toFixed(2)}`);

        if (!isFinite(mgPerM2)) {
          finalTag = 'C3';
        } else if (mgPerM2 > 12.0) {
          finalTag = 'A';
        } else {
          finalTag = 'B';
        }
        break; // Done
      } catch (innerErr) {
        // This dataset attempt failed (e.g., invalid ID/band); move on
        continue;
      }
    }

    if (!finalTag) {
      if (!foundImages) {
        console.log('No images in all candidates for date/location.');
        finalTag = 'C1';
      } else if (seenNoValidPixels) {
        console.log('Images exist but no valid pixels after processing.');
        finalTag = 'C2';
      } else {
        // Likely band mismatch or other logical failure
        finalTag = 'C3';
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Unhandled error (e.g., dataset not accessible, memory, syntax)
    finalTag = 'D';
  }

  console.log(finalTag);
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
